tokens.name: Gossip
tokens.text: Search your bag for a token of your choice.

tokens.name: Wits
tokens.text: Steal a token from your opponent's hand.

tokens.name: Misinformation
tokens.text: Stops draws for the round when drawn. Action to turn into chatter.

tokens.name: Blackmail
tokens.text: When a noble goes to move, take control of another their movement.

tokens.name: Rumor
tokens.text: When another noble takes an action, cancel it.

tokens.name: Chatter
tokens.text: When returning this token to the bag, discard it instead.
